authority: This literal payload; design table must match each literal_markdown_row exactly.

rules.positive_evidence: Identified assets are encumbered or checked to secure a scoped obligation
rules.literal_markdown_row: | `R-collateralization` / mechanisms | Identified assets are encumbered or checked to secure a scoped obligation | A product merely holds assets |

rules.positive_evidence: A rule or authorized actor distributes capital or exposure across identified destinations
rules.literal_markdown_row: | `R-allocation` / mechanisms | A rule or authorized actor distributes capital or exposure across identified destinations | Holding an underlying allocation product |

rules.positive_evidence: A holder can submit a claim/token for settlement against backing or payout under stated conditions
rules.literal_markdown_row: | `R-redemption` / mechanisms | A holder can submit a claim/token for settlement against backing or payout under stated conditions | Secondary-market sale; borrower repayment alone |

rules.positive_evidence: The scoped operation creates or destroys token/claim supply, with authority identified
rules.insufficient_alone: Transfer into custody or return of existing inventory
rules.literal_markdown_row: | `R-mint_burn` / mechanisms | The scoped operation creates or destroys token/claim supply, with authority identified | Transfer into custody or return of existing inventory |

rules.positive_evidence: A rule-triggered process closes, reduces or resolves an undercollateralized/defaulted position and specifies debt/collateral consequences
rules.insufficient_alone: Unscoped parent terminology or ordinary voluntary redemption
rules.literal_markdown_row: | `R-liquidation` / mechanisms | A rule-triggered process closes, reduces or resolves an undercollateralized/defaulted position and specifies debt/collateral consequences | Unscoped parent terminology or ordinary voluntary redemption |

rules.positive_evidence: The product directly supplies management/allocation of users' pooled or delegated capital
rules.insufficient_alone: Incidental treasury management inside another service
rules.literal_markdown_row: | `R-asset_management` / economic_functions | The product directly supplies management/allocation of users' pooled or delegated capital | Incidental treasury management inside another service |

rules.positive_evidence: The direct product grants a claim on performance/assets enforced or settled outside its on-chain state machine
rules.literal_markdown_row: | `R-offchain_claims` / economic_functions | The direct product grants a claim on performance/assets enforced or settled outside its on-chain state machine | Merely centralized operation or branding |

rules.positive_evidence: The scoped product directly enables trading/exchanging instruments between participants or against a pool
rules.literal_markdown_row: | `R-exchange` / economic_functions | The scoped product directly enables trading/exchanging instruments between participants or against a pool | Issuing/resolving an event claim alone |

rules.positive_evidence: The exposed instrument transfers current ownership/control of an asset, without being only a derivative or future-contingent claim
rules.insufficient_alone: A spot underlying referenced by a derivative
rules.literal_markdown_row: | `R-spot_asset` / instruments | The exposed instrument transfers current ownership/control of an asset, without being only a derivative or future-contingent claim | A spot underlying referenced by a derivative |

rules.positive_evidence: The instrument gives a proportional beneficial/economic interest in a defined managed fund pool
rules.insufficient_alone: Generic token name or pooled custody without share rights
rules.literal_markdown_row: | `R-fund_share` / instruments | The instrument gives a proportional beneficial/economic interest in a defined managed fund pool | Generic token name or pooled custody without share rights |

rules.positive_evidence: The scoped service executes on a dedicated application chain with its execution/settlement role stated
rules.insufficient_alone: A chain brand or unrelated organization service
rules.literal_markdown_row: | `R-appchain` / execution | The scoped service executes on a dedicated application chain with its execution/settlement role stated | A chain brand or unrelated organization service |

rules.positive_evidence: A scoped workflow has causally linked transitions in distinct domains with an explicit delivery/finality boundary
rules.literal_markdown_row: | `R-async_cross_domain` / execution | A scoped workflow has causally linked transitions in distinct domains with an explicit delivery/finality boundary | Tokens available on multiple chains |

rules.positive_evidence: A scoped obligation is discharged or enforced through a stated off-chain legal settlement process
rules.insufficient_alone: Custody alone or unspecified centralized processing
rules.literal_markdown_row: | `R-offchain_legal_settlement` / execution | A scoped obligation is discharged or enforced through a stated off-chain legal settlement process | Custody alone or unspecified centralized processing |

rules.positive_evidence: A named role supplies an attestation accepted as evidence for a financial transition
rules.insufficient_alone: Any signature or ordinary transaction authorization
rules.literal_markdown_row: | `R-attester` / trust | A named role supplies an attestation accepted as evidence for a financial transition | Any signature or ordinary transaction authorization |

rules.positive_evidence: A named role chooses strategy, eligible assets/counterparties or capital allocation relied on by users
rules.insufficient_alone: Passive operator name or validator participation
rules.literal_markdown_row: | `R-curator` / trust | A named role chooses strategy, eligible assets/counterparties or capital allocation relied on by users | Passive operator name or validator participation |

rules.positive_evidence: A named authority controls issuance of the scoped claim/token or the promise it represents
rules.literal_markdown_row: | `R-issuer` / trust | A named authority controls issuance of the scoped claim/token or the promise it represents | Merely hosting an interface |

rules.positive_evidence: An external actor is relied on to trigger/maintain a required state transition with its role stated
rules.insufficient_alone: The mere existence of callable functions
rules.literal_markdown_row: | `R-keeper` / trust | An external actor is relied on to trigger/maintain a required state transition with its role stated | The mere existence of callable functions |

rules.insufficient_alone: A custodian label without the relevant obligation
rules.literal_markdown_row: | `R-legal_obligor` / trust | A named entity owes an identifiable legally grounded performance/payment obligation to the holder | A custodian label without the relevant obligation |
